transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the production plan for the next window. We need to cover 240 Model X motor drives and 120 Model Y motor drives. I'm aware we currently have only 600 power modules released for use, with additional units sitting in quality-hold. Before I make any allocation decisions, I need to hear from each of you — process engineering, quality, logistics, and product compliance — on the status of those held modules and any other constraints that could affect the plan. Let's work through this systematically.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important from my engineering bill-of-materials review. After the latest engineering change, I confirmed that each Model X drive requires exactly 2 power modules and each Model Y drive requires exactly 1 power module. I completed this review but haven't yet entered the revised quantities in the planning system, so the system may still be showing outdated figures. Based on these confirmed requirements, producing 240 Model X drives would need 480 power modules and 120 Model Y drives would need 120 power modules, for a total of 600 power modules — which exactly matches our currently released quantity.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share what I found during my inspection of the quality-hold area. Exactly 150 of the held modules can be recovered after a 6-hour controlled bake followed by insulation testing. I documented this result in a local inspection worksheet, but it hasn't been attached to the material record yet, so it wouldn't show up in the system. This means we could potentially have up to 750 released power modules available if we run the recovery process on those 150 units.

The Model X order can ship as 180 drives on Friday and 60 drives on Monday, while the Model Y customer requires all 120 drives on Friday. This means Friday's shipment requirement is 180 Model X drives plus 120 Model Y drives — 300 drives total — with the remaining 60 Model X drives following on Monday.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical compliance requirement from my destination review. Every Model Y drive must have serialized power-module traceability and a lot-specific compliance certificate before shipment. I completed the review for the export destination but have not yet added this requirement to the dispatch checklist, so it wouldn't be visible there.
